notes: Reaction Mode config + data model. A fast reflex game: the app throws CUES, the user RESPONDS with a real movement (strike/defend/move/tap), scored on reaction time + accuracy. Spec: specs/25-reaction-mode.md. Uses the shared voice-guidance timer (specs/22) and can feed Ghost Battles (specs/24). HONESTY: this is task-specific response practice + conditioning + engagement — NOT a proven general-reflex booster (transfer is debated in our striking/speed research). Copy never promises 'faster reflexes everywhere' or anime auto-dodge.

cue_types.VOICE_CALL: Coach voice calls a strike/combo/number ('jab-cross!', 'TWO'). Uses voice-guidance TTS + the campaign voice pack.
cue_types.SCREEN_SIGNAL: A colour / number / arrow flashes (visual reaction).
cue_types.ATTACK_CUE: A slip/roll/block prompt — an incoming attack to defend ('SLIP LEFT').
cue_types.GO_NO_GO: Respond only to VALID cues, hold on invalid ones (strike on GREEN, freeze on RED) — decision/inhibition.
cue_types.CHOICE: Different cues map to different responses (1->jab, 2->cross, 3->slip) — choice reaction (harder).

response_types.STRIKE: Throw the called strike/combo (shadow or bag). Detect via device-motion strike detection or a timed self-report tap.
response_types.DEFEND: Slip / roll / block the called attack.
response_types.MOVE: Touch a target, change direction, drop to a squat, lateral shuffle (agility/footwork; fit-friendly, no striking).
response_types.TAP: Screen/pad tap — minimal fallback when no space/bag.

hard.label: UNTOUCHABLE
hard.note: Faster and more decisions — NEVER removes the warm-up or the form/joint safety caps.

difficulty_scaling.safety_rides_alongside: Warm-up required, form-over-speed, wrist/shoulder protection for bag work, no explosive reaction under heavy fatigue — these do NOT scale away with difficulty.

scoring.false_start_rule: Reacting BEFORE the response window opens = a miss (keeps it honest reaction, not anticipation).
scoring.reflex_score: Composite of speed (mean_reaction_ms) and accuracy_pct, penalized by false_starts. Task-specific only — no transfer claim.
scoring.xp: Normal session XP for completing; bonus XP for a new best reflex_score. A miss/slow round never punishes showing up.
scoring.rank_note: Ranks reflect performance at THIS task only — never framed as general/real-life reflex ability.

fight.framing: React to the phantom — Combo Coach / Fight Focus companion. Garou/Ultra Instinct 'sense the attack' skin.
fight.voice_pack: inherits the fight discipline / campaign pack

fit.framing: Quick feet — agility & footwork quickness (Sonic speed pillars). No striking required.

surfaces.session_length: Short by default (it's intense): a few 60-120s rounds.

integrations.voice_guidance: Cues + counts + safety spoken by the shared audio-guided timer (specs/22); the active voice pack skins the calls.
integrations.combo_streak: Completing a Reaction session counts toward the COMBO streak (specs/23).
integrations.ghost_battles: Can produce a reaction-time GHOST — a race against your own best reaction_score (specs/24, win by faster mean_reaction_ms). Fight-mode-first, like other ghosts.

rules: WARM-UP FIRST — shoulders/wrists for striking, ankles for footwork/dodge; explosive reactions never start cold.
FORM OVER SPEED — a fast but sloppy or through-pain response scores WORSE, not better; the quality gate stays on.
PROTECT HANDS/SHOULDERS — wrap + gloves for any bag striking; never bare-knuckle.
CONTROLLED DEFENSE — dodge/roll responses reuse the ankle-first / soft-landing safety (no flips, controlled only).
NO REACTION UNDER HEAVY FATIGUE — stop while responses are still clean.
safety_scaffolding.stop_action: Any stop criterion halts the session with a plain caution and no XP penalty.

trainable_real: Task-specific response practice (throwing/defending the called action)
Simple/choice reaction time improves AT the trained task with practice
not_established: That it makes your reflexes faster in general life or other sports (transfer is debated — not among supported claims in the Sonic/Garou research)
